<!--
Thanks for the idea! Please search existing issues and discussions first.
For open-ended ideas or questions, Discussions is often the better home:
https://github.com/ohmforge/ohmforge/discussions
-->

## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do, and what makes it hard today? Describe the use case rather than jumping straight to a solution.

## Proposed solution

What you would like to happen. (Optional — a clear problem is enough to start.)

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches or workarounds you have tried or thought about.

## Scope

- [ ] Simulation core (`ohmforge-core` / `ohmforge-sim`)
- [ ] Boards / MCU (`ohmforge-digital` / `ohmforge-mcu` / `ohmforge-devices`)
- [ ] UI / shell / instruments (`ohmforge-tui` / `ohmforge-shell` / `ohmforge-instruments`)
- [ ] AI / formats (`ohmforge-ai` / `ohmforge-fmt`)
- [ ] Web (`ohmforge-web`)
- [ ] Docs / examples
- [ ] Other / not sure

## Additional context

Links, references, sketches, or example circuits that illustrate the idea.
